Fikra hayla! (The tutor checks: news, source, comment, a question to the interlocutor.) yizʿalu Angry singers ḥabaṭṭalha I'll stop. bi-balāš Free of charge agānib "Trainers" is the name of the company. Exercise 4 · Examples. a) fēn il-maṣdar? ma-fīš ism garīda wala tarīḫ. ḫallīni adawwar ʿala mawʾiʿ il-wizāra. · b) iṣ-ṣūra of ʾadīma, ana šuftaha min sanatēn. il-ḫabar miš min in-naharda. · c) il-garīda maʿrūfa, bass ḫallīni adawwar ʿal-ḫabar ʿala mawʾiʿha nafsu ʿašān atʾakkid. · d) mīn ili biyʾūl Kida? fīh bayān Rasmi? «biyʾūlu» miš maṣdar. Personal answer. The tutor checks that the map of the registers and positions correspond to the extract and that the Italian review gives every opinion to those who express it. Exercise 8. a) Prices (tomatoes). Start in fuṣḥā (Good evening, tonight we are dealing with the issue of rising prices) and then immediately passes to Egyptian. The expert says that the main cause is the price of the dollar and imports; Šarīf adds traders who take advantage of the situation. That the expert pronounces istiṯmār with the s; Šarīf explains that in the words coming from fuṣḥā ⁧ث⁩ and ⁧ذ⁩ become s and z, and that the official words are said with q (al-Qāhira on the news, il-ʾAhira at home). b) That the university exams in Egypt will be cancelled; On Facebook, in the family group, sent by a friend. Newspaper name, source, date. The denial of yesterday's ministry: examinations will be held regularly. Send her the link of denial and kindly tell her to check before forwarding anything. c) The traffic in Cairo. The Doctor Ḥusām, professor of urban planning. The number of cars has grown faster than public transport. He agrees that the state has built many overpasses and roads, but he says it is not enough. The solution: metro in all neighborhoods, clean and regular buses, so people leave their cars at home. Fuṣḥā: «masāʾ al-ḫayr, wa ahlan bikum. natanāwal al-layla...bi-šakl ʿāmm».
